name: sol8-source-controls
goal: Show open selection options, empty-file status and linked filenames in every responsive catalog capture

evidence: Select options must be painted in-page; empty files must show an explicit status; linked filenames must be visibly underlined; lightbox shots frame their real content.
Existing tests accepted native open state without painted options, empty code, and control counts without link paint. Existing catalog assertions now check those pixels and semantics after capture.
Red 8ee814b5 at dac1ace686 retains 96 responsive captures and fails the painted-listbox, empty-file status and linked-filename guards.
3701740174 renders visible Select options, explicit empty-file status and underlined filenames without changing the frozen tests.
36886229 passes the unchanged 96-case matrix at 3701740174 against red b880db3e, using the same fixed runtime environment.
